result:
Clean typecheck and all 617 existing tests pass. The implementation is complete:

**`src/server/services/member-service.ts`** — added `suspendMember`, `reinstateMember`, and `MemberSuspendedError`; refactored the last-owner check to only count non-suspended owners.

**`src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts`** — added `suspendMember`/`reinstateMember` writes; fixed `archiveMember` to stop stamping removed rows with `status: "suspended"`; widened `countActiveMembers` to include suspended (seat-holding) members.

**`src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts`** — seat rollup now counts suspended members too.

**`src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts`** — org switcher (`listOrgsForUser`) excludes suspended memberships.

**`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`** / **`digest-service.ts`** — suspended recipients get no notifications and are skipped by the digest.

**`src/server/services/comment-service.ts`** — suspended members are dropped from `@mention` resolution (handle and client-supplied id alike).

**`src/server/services/issue-service.ts`** — creating or assigning an issue to a suspended member now throws `MemberSuspendedError`.

**`src/types/event.ts`**, **`src/types/activity.ts`**, **`src/schemas/activity.ts`**, **`src/server/services/activity-service.ts`**, **`src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`** — added `member.suspended`/`member.reinstated` as domain events and audit-log actions, wired into the listener registry and label map.

`resolveActor`/`resolveActorForOrg`/`switchActiveOrg` already gated on `status === "active"`, so suspended members were already correctly locked out of acting and switching into the org — no changes needed there.
